messages:
Alex Chen: quick handoff — i'm heading offline for ~30m. handing primary to @Tasha, @Mike as secondary. tl;dr: eu-west embeddings ingest has elevated errors + p99 latency since ~10:12 UTC. we rolled back the last quant-config change and bumped worker pool +2. fallback enabled for priority customers. some batch jobs are still failing (partnerX), search indexing for product-y has partial failures. i left the bridge open until 10:30 and pinned current checks below. leaving notes + links. :wave:

incident-bot: [INC-2026-8432] created — Embedded Ingest Degradation (eu-west). page sent to eng-oncall. status: active.

Tasha Patel: ack, taking primary. thanks alex. i'll keep the bridge. can you paste the exact commands you used for the rollback?

Alex Chen: pasted below — i ran the quick rollback to previous quant config and scaled deployment. commands:
```bash
# rollback quant-config (k8s configmap)
kubectl -n embeddings set configmap quant-config --from-file=quant-v1.json
# restart batcher pods
kubectl -n embeddings rollout restart deploy/embeddings-batcher
# scale up temporally
kubectl -n embeddings scale deploy/embeddings-batcher --replicas=6
```
logs look like a mix of OOM-ish traces + RPC timeouts earlier. after the rollback we saw errors drop but p99 still elevated.

Mike Ortega: @Tasha noted. i'll keep an eye on infra alerts and check the autoscaler configs. is there any region failover we should flip on for the critical customers?

Tasha Patel: good q. for now i've enabled fallback to the on-host quantized model for the priority customer list (partnerX, core-search). that reduces quality slightly but keeps success rate. region failover requires ops approval; i'll ping infra if we need it.

Sara Nguyen: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-degradation — the checklist is there but it's missing the new quant-config rollback step you did, alex. tagging @sre-runbook-bot to create a PR reminder.

sre-runbook-bot: created runbook-pr task RB-678 (update embeddings degradation runbook to include quant-config rollback step).

Alex Chen: i filed a follow-up infra ticket for the autoscaler thresholds (INF-2345) and a customer ops ticket for partner outreach (PM-1122). brief notes: INF-2345 — adjust headroom and add a warm pool for embeddings-batcher; PM-1122 — notify partnerX about partial failures and mitigation in place.

Tasha Patel: thanks. action items from my side: 1) validate fallbacks are holding for next 30m, 2) confirm INF-2345 priority with infra, 3) coordinate with support to send initial customer note for partnerX. i'll update this thread with status.

Mike Ortega: i'll audit autoscaler config and post findings here. quick check i ran: `curl -sS https://internal-metrics/recent?metric=embeddings_latency` — p95 down a bit but p99 still elevated.

Alex Chen: extra notes: there's a ~10% increase in retries at the proxy layer during the spike window. attached the small grep i used earlier: `kubectl logs ... | grep "rpc timeout" | wc -l`. expect we need a small follow-up perf tuning.

Tasha Patel: confirmed fallback tests passing for partnerX (sample job succeeded). i'm going to escalate INF-2345 to P1.

incident-bot: update — INC-2026-8432: mitigation in progress, fallbacks enabled, rollbacks applied. assigned owners: primary=Tasha Patel, secondary=Mike Ortega.

Sara Nguyen: to capture follow-ups:
- update runbook (RB-678) — assigned to Alex for draft, due EOD
- infra ticket INF-2345 — assigned to infra-squad, due 48h
- customer outreach PM-1122 — assigned to support, draft by EOD
- postmortem + retro — schedule 

Tasha Patel: proposing retro: 2026-03-15 16:00 UTC (30m). i created calendar event and invited eng-oncall, infra, support, and product. please accept.

Alex Chen: accepted. i'll draft initial timeline + logs and add to the calendar invite.

Mike Ortega: quick note about coverage: i'm oncall in 2h but will be switching to a different slot overnight — if anything remains open after the retro schedule we should ensure the overnight oncall knows context. i'll write a short handoff blurb if needed.

Tasha Patel: good call — assign follow-up if anything outstanding to the next oncall. i'll add a short summary in the ticket INF-2345 for the overnight person.

sre-runbook-bot: RB-678 PR opened: https://git.redwood.internal/rb/embeddings/678 — includes quant rollback checklist and verification steps.

Alex Chen: final before i go offline: last checks i ran at 10:28 UTC show error-rate back to ~baseline for non-batched traffic, batch job retries reduced but not zero (partnerX 4/10 succeeded). leaving bridge + pinned checks. thanks all — Tasha, you're primary.

Tasha Patel: thanks alex — noted. leaving short summary for overnight: primary=Tasha, secondary=Mike, known impact=partnerX batch jobs partial failures, mitigation=quant rollback + worker scale + fallback for priority customers, tickets INF-2345 (infra), PM-1122 (customer outreach), RB-678 (runbook update). retro on 2026-03-15 16:00 UTC.

incident-bot: INC-2026-8432 — handoff recorded. handoff_by=Alex Chen, handoff_to=Tasha Patel, handoff_time=1767456860.

Mike Ortega: logged a small follow-up note in INF-2345 about autoscaler hysteresis.

Sara Nguyen: thx team. i'll own the runbook merge once Alex's draft is in. please ping if anything changes. :heart:

Tasha Patel: closing notes: if p99 doesn't drop after scaleback we will open a circuit to eu-west for non-critical indexing jobs to protect user-facing traffic. i'll update here if we hit that.

Alex Chen: back soon. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: thread archived for INC-2026-8432 (temporary archive until incident closed).
